notes.title: Create levels for Selfless Heroes
notes.notes:
Starting with v1.2.8 you can create levels for Selfless Heroes.

The published levels will be accessible in a dedicated section of the game in a future release. I'm waiting until there are enough levels created by the community before introducing this feature in the game.

Read the guides on GitHub to get started: [url=https://github.com/felicien-brochu/selflessheroes/blob/master/leveleditor/doc/README.md]https://github.com/felicien-brochu/selflessheroes/blob/master/leveleditor/doc/README.md[/url]


Ask the community for help on how to create levels on [url=https://discord.gg/UtKrrBM]Discord[/url].
